conservative_decisions.decision: four fixed arms A--D; the model parameters are byte-for-byte the published XGBoost baseline parameters
conservative_decisions.reason: only the feature budget may vary, so no model search, validation split, early stopping, rebalancing, or threshold search is introduced

conservative_decisions.decision: P6 undefined values remain NaN and use XGBoost's native missing branch
conservative_decisions.reason: imputation, a fitted fill value, or a missingness indicator would modify the audited feature and widen the registered budget

conservative_decisions.decision: P1 folds are reconstructed to recover P1's authentic training-row order and then proven equal to the frozen folds
conservative_decisions.reason: p1_folds.json preserves membership but sorts ids; all arms must share P1's actual order and exactly the same ordered test rows

conservative_decisions.decision: online validity is assessed from the exact P6 formulas and their source quantities, without using absolute time
conservative_decisions.reason: interarrival_mean uses differences of relative starts only; the two byte features use counters available by window close; historical extraction is from FlowEnd evidence, so deployment latency itself is not measured

conservative_decisions.decision: candidate-minus-ARM-A recall deltas use a paired bootstrap over the same episode ids
conservative_decisions.reason: all arms see the same 40 botnet episodes; resampling windows would be pseudoreplication and comparing marginal intervals alone would discard the pairing

checks.detail: all retained offsets are in [0, 60); absolute timestamps do not reach a feature

bytes_per_packet_destination.policy: native NaN; no imputation and no indicator

distinct_payload_ratio.policy: native NaN; no imputation and no indicator

interarrival_mean.policy: native NaN; no imputation and no indicator

bytes_per_packet_destination.guard: uses destination byte and packet counters available by window close; undefined denominator remains NaN

interarrival_mean.derivation: mean of consecutive start-time differences; undefined for n<2
interarrival_mean.guard: only consecutive differences of relative starts in [0,60) are used

online_validity.historical_evidence_caveat: values are reconstructed from persisted FlowEnd evidence; the formulas use no future window, but this benchmark does not measure streaming ingestion latency or availability of late flow records
online_validity.status: ONLINE formulas under the P6 window-close convention

question: do interarrival_mean and/or bytes_per_packet_destination improve botnet/Ares detection beyond distinct_payload_ratio?

r11.demonstrates: within-protocol transfer to held-out Ares windows and marginal feature-budget differences on the same episodes
r11.does_not_demonstrate: generalisation to other victims, attackers, captures, botnet families, or operational streaming latency

threshold_rule: training negatives only at 1% and 0.1%; no test observation selects a threshold
